title: Scene Mesh Z Up Correction Sign
description: Flip per-object GLB mesh correction from -90deg to +90deg X so assets face up.
summary: Per-object GLB frame correction changed from rotation −π/2 to +π/2 about local X (OBJECT_MESH_FRAME_Z_UP_TO_Y_UP) so kit meshes face up instead of down; Vitest green.
